explicit_denies.reason: Default deny: host, method and path must match an explicit entry.
Interactive docs are not test traffic.
Documentation UI is not test traffic.
Contract metadata is not ordinary business traffic.
Uploaded spec points to an external HTB host; do not replay against it as your app.

runtrace_rules: Match exact HTTP method and normalized path template; do not allow broad prefix-only matching.
Resolve path IDs only from the current seeded run or a recorded create-response dependency.
Only use the synthetic actor identities created by seed(2).py.
Do not mutate tenant_id, owner_id, role, permissions, or other protected fields except in a separately approved negative-test case.
For cross-actor authorization tests, actor switching is permitted only among seeded synthetic accounts; record actor_id, role, tenant_id and session_id.
Workflow actions require a valid precondition and expected state transition.
Delete, reset and admin actions require explicit approval and disposable data; they are not autonomous baseline traffic.
Store request/response hashes and redacted evidence; never store bearer tokens, passwords, OTPs or payment secrets.
A request being allowlisted means it is in-scope, not that its response is a vulnerability verdict.
